task_instance: Tie out one LP's quarterly capital account statement (Riverstone Pension Trust, Alder Growth Fund III LP, Q2 2026) against the fund's NAV pack: recompute beginning capital, contributions, distributions, allocated net income, carried interest, and ending capital from the NAV pack's fund-level P&L/fee data and the LP's ownership %, then compare line-by-line to the generated statement with a 0.01 tolerance, plus the 'ending capital = next period draft beginning capital' cross-check.
evidence: Created sample input documents lp_statement.json (the generated LP statement under test, with an intentionally injected error: it used 12.40% ownership) and nav_pack.json (the source-of-truth NAV pack, with actual ownership 12.38%, fund-level realized/unrealized P&L, management fee, fund expenses, commitment register, and next-period draft beginning capital) in the work directory. The skill's SKILL.md says the NAV pack is normally pulled 'via the nav MCP', but no such MCP tool exists in this runtime's tool list and MCP/connector tools are forbidden by the safety rules regardless; since the NAV pack is itself just input data (a document a preparer/back-office would supply), it was created as a sample input file rather than fabricated as if it were live MCP tool output, consistent with the rule allowing sample INPUT data. Wrote tieout.py, which implements the skill's recompute formula (Beginning capital + Contributions - Distributions + LP% x (realized+unrealized PnL - mgmt fee - fund expenses) - Carry = Ending capital) plus the 'ending capital == next period draft beginning capital' cross-check, and outputs a pass/fail per line with recomputed vs statement values and a flags list, matching the skill's required Output section format. Ran `python3 tieout.py lp_statement.json nav_pack.json` from the work directory; it correctly produced PASS for Beginning capital, Contributions, Distributions, and Carried interest, and correctly FAILED Allocated net income/(loss) and Ending capital, with the flag note 'allocated P&L differs - statement used 12.40% ownership, NAV pack shows 12.38%' (matching the exact example phrasing in SKILL.md), and also flagged the downstream next-period draft beginning-capital mismatch. Output was saved to tieout_report.json (2177 bytes) in the work directory and verified by inspecting its JSON contents.
